svg.text: MOE SYSTEMS ARCHITECTURE: DEEPEP (NORMAL & IBGDA), DUAL-BATCH OVERLAP & EPLB
DeepEP IBGDA + Two-Batch Ping-Pong Overlap + EPLB Cuts Exposed Comm Stall to 1.8%
64x H200 (EP=64) DeepSeek-R1 671B: Tier 1 Generic All-to-All (54.8% Stall, 520 TPS) vs. Tier 4 (1.8% Stall, 2,380 TPS, $0.25/1M)
⛔ Tier 1 Traps: Blocking All-to-All & Hot-Expert Skew
1. Why Generic NCCL `All-to-All` Stalls 54.8% of MoE Step Time:
• Every MoE layer requires 2 cross-node `All-to-All` collectives
(`Dispatch` + `Combine`); CPU proxy latency hits `820us` per call!
2. Serial Compute-Then-Communicate Bubble:
• Without micro-batch ping-pong overlap, all 64 GPUs sit idle
waiting for RDMA packets twice on every single Transformer layer
3. Hot-Expert Straggler Skew (`3.85x` Max-to-Mean Token Load):
• 1 overloaded GPU holding a popular coding expert stalls 63 GPUs!
Tier 1 Generic MoE Deployment Failure Impact (EP=64):
• Exposed All-to-All Stall: 54.8% | Decode All-to-All: 820us
• Hot-Expert Skew Ratio: 3.85x | Goodput: Only 520 tok/s/GPU
• Cost per 1M Tokens: $1.18 / 1M
🏆 Tier 4: DeepEP IBGDA + Ping-Pong Overlap + EPLB
1. Dual-Mode `DeepEP` Kernels (`Normal` vs. `Low-Latency IBGDA`):
• Prefill uses NVLink->RDMA forwarding (`24 SMs`); Decode uses
pure `IBGDA` GPU-direct NIC doorbell ringing (`168us` latency!)
2. `DualPipe` / Two-Batch Ping-Pong Overlap (`Batch A <-> Batch B`):
• Overlaps `Batch A` RDMA Dispatch/Combine with `Batch B` MLA
Attention & Expert GEMM—hiding `96.7%` of communication time!
3. Hierarchical `EPLB` (Redundant Hot-Expert Replication):
• Replicates top-5% hot experts across nodes (`3.85x -> 1.09x` skew)
Tier 4 Verified Production Benchmarks (EP=64):
• Exposed All-to-All Stall: 1.8% | Decode IBGDA Latency: 168us
• Hot-Expert Skew: 1.09x | Goodput: 2,380 tok/s/GPU (4.58x!)
• Cost per 1M Tokens: $0.25 / 1M (-78.8% savings vs. Tier 1)
